author: Zack Larry
quote: You can close the vehicle door and take the scanner all the way around the vehicle
summary: Describes the freedom to move around the car with the wireless interface. Active-test support still depends on the exact vehicle.

author: ribb313

author: Petertwit
context: Manufacturer-hosted review · Received free product · Source shows “8 years ago”
quote: Easy release and control to lower vehicle.

author: TOsborn
context: Manufacturer-hosted customer review · Source shows “6 years ago”
